Root cause: Bun.file().exists() returns false for Unix domain sockets because it checks isFile(), which is false for socket inodes. The bd.sock socket was always preserved — the test assertion method was wrong. Fix: replaced Bun.file().exists() with fs.stat().isSocket() for the socket check.
